title: トワイライトシンドローム 探索編
sources: Genkan memory search during play: own 16-bit table, あ = 0x0001 in gojuon order
From the disc: fonts and scripts decompressed, the font file's order worked out, and each of the six chapters' scripts paired with its font by how many of its kanji make words

Glyphs: 2,599 of the 2,881 chapter codes are bit for bit ones read for Kyuumei-hen (SLPS-00405); the other 282 (210 different glyphs) were read by eye. Every scene's script was then decoded and checked against a word list; 19 codes no scene uses are unchecked
Five Genkan RAM snapshots of the opening (inbox): the running script decodes to the lines that were on screen, and the script position was found by comparing them
notes: 16-bit little-endian codes, not Kyuumei-hen's (SLPS-00405): 0x0000-0x0108 are the same in every chapter; kanji are 0x010C up and each chapter numbers its own, so one of SLPS-00102-ch0.tbl, -ch1, -ch2, -ch3, -ch4, -chX must follow the shared table. The format can't choose a table yet and the byte that says the chapter isn't known, so only the shared one is listed and kanji read as unmapped. The running script is at 0x801FE800; the u16 at 0x800A4CEA counts the words read (opening only seen). No layout: a page cursor must be an address. Two more fonts on the disc belong to no script found.
